projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

insights.summary: The stable presence of 16-18 mobile devices combined with zero camera activity on a weekday mid-morning strongly indicates the camera system may be offline or malfunctioning, as active children and dogs would typically trigger motion alerts. Verify camera connectivity to ensure security monitoring remains active.

The device count stabilizing at 16-18 after the 08:42 drop indicates most household members are likely still home, but the complete lack of camera activity for four hours suggests the cameras are offline, in privacy mode, or motion detection is disabled, leaving the home unmonitored during a typical active morning.

The steady decline in connected mobile devices (from ~24 to 16) combined with zero camera activity strongly indicates the family has already departed for school and work. This aligns with typical Thursday morning routines, confirming the house is likely empty and operating normally.

The persistent 23-24 device count throughout the night, combined with zero camera motion at 3:47 AM, strongly suggests UniFi presence detection is miscounting IoT/smart home devices as mobile phones rather than indicating unrecorded late-night activity; verifying network device classification is recommended.

The sustained 23-24 connected devices at 12:42 AM, paired with zero camera motion and the adults' extended sleep cycle, confirms a settled sleepover with guests stationary in common or guest areas. This warrants proactive management of guest room climate/lighting and perimeter security for the atypical occupancy.

The stabilization of network presence at 23 devices alongside fresh sleep data showing ~9.5 hours of rest for both adults confirms the household has transitioned smoothly into a quiet, settled nighttime state with no signs of disruption or unexpected activity.

The device count has remained consistently high (22-23) for over two hours past a typical weekday wind-down, indicating a stable, ongoing gathering rather than a transient visit. Steve should anticipate guests staying late and possible extended use of shared spaces.

The high device count combined with zero camera activity suggests guests are likely stationary indoors or IoT devices are skewing the count; verify the gathering is expected and check camera motion settings.

The sustained presence of 20-24 connected devices during the early evening strongly indicates an after-school gathering or family visit. With no camera alerts, the event is likely indoors, so you may want to monitor network load and keep the dogs secured during the visit.

Network presence jumped from 16 to 22 devices in just five minutes (17:23–17:28), strongly indicating multiple family members or guests arriving home simultaneously. This rapid influx suggests the household is transitioning to full occupancy, which may warrant confirming visitor status or triggering evening routines.
